tours.texte: pg_partman first. run the ALTER EXTENSION on staging 16.4 (rw url this time), then check maintenance on events_raw and events_daily. if thats green we apply the staging plan

```
ALTER EXTENSION pg_partman UPDATE TO '5.1.0';   -- 4.7.4 → 5.1.0
CALL partman.run_maintenance_proc();
```
- `partman.part_config` migrated by the extension script (the `partition_type` column is gone, both parents are native).
- Maintenance ran without errors; premade partitions exist up to 2026-12-08 for `events_raw` (daily) and 2027-02 for `events_daily` (monthly).
- No lock waits during the run (dbt isn't running at this hour).

Green on both tables.
ok apply the staging plan. go

The apply failed when creating the blue/green deployment:

```
Error: creating RDS Blue/Green Deployment (analytics-staging): InvalidParameterCombination:
Blue/Green Deployments for PostgreSQL require logical replication. Set the
rds.logical_replication parameter to 1 in the DB parameter group of the source
DB instance and reboot the instance.
```

So the source (16.4) parameter group needs `rds.logical_replication = 1`, which is a static parameter: it needs a reboot (≈ 2 min of downtime on staging). Prod will need the same thing.
reboot is fine on staging. do it

- `rds.logical_replication = 1` added to the pg16 parameter group (module, `apply_method = "pending-reboot"`), applied, instance rebooted (1m48s).
- New plan, apply: green environment created in 24 minutes.
- Switchover at 14:20 UTC: 41 seconds where writes were refused, then traffic on the green instance.

`analytics-staging` now runs PostgreSQL 17.2. Committed as `7e3c9d4` (logical replication in the module) and `b0f18a2` (staging engine 17.2). I started `dbt run --select events_daily --target staging` in the background.
